game: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
build: Official Ask the Developer Vol. 9 and product documentation
observations: Developers describe adding valuable cave entrances to formerly bare cliff faces so one discovery changes how players inspect other cliffs.
The world connects surface, sky, and underground layers rather than treating each as an unrelated selection screen.
Ascend converts ceilings, hillsides, and some other overhead geometry into potential shortcuts.
inferences: A useful environmental difference can teach a reusable exploration question rather than merely contain one reward.
New movement rules are strongest when they alter how familiar geometry is read.
limits: Developer explanation establishes intent and examples, not universal player response.
This bounded record does not evaluate the complete world or every cave reward.
